intro: This trial, set directly by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, tasks rising heroes with hunting down the great kodo beast Arra'chea across the plains of Mulgore. Though an initiate may have completed the traditional rites of passage, Cairne expects his people to continually reaffirm their strength, tracking, and devotion to the tribe. Returning with Arra'chea's horn proves an adventurer is ready to serve the wider Horde beyond the mesas.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have passed the Rites of the Earthmother and earned your place in Thunder Bluff.
But in order to maintain the spot that you strived so hard to achieve, you must continue to prove your worth to your people.
We are hunters, friend. Down below in Mulgore there is a mighty kodo named Arra'chea. Show me your skills in the ways of tracking and hunting by bringing me the Horn of Arra'chea.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you tracked down Arra'chea yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done! A fine kill that was.
I will send a gathering party to collect the carcass so we can retrieve the hide and meat.
You have done a great deed for your people, friend.
